mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_cost_rate_card ( rate_card_id, provider_id, model_id, input_token_cost_per_1k, output_token_cost_per_1k, tool_call_cost, effective_from, effective_to ) VALUES ( #{rateCardCode}, #{providerCode}, #{modelCode}, #{inputTokenCostPer1k}, #{outputTokenCostPer1k}, #{toolCallCost}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo} )
mapper.select: SELECT rate_card_id, provider_id, model_id, input_token_cost_per_1k, output_token_cost_per_1k, tool_call_cost, effective_from, effective_to FROM tb_cost_rate_card WHERE provider_id = #{providerCode} AND model_id = #{modelCode} AND effective_from <= #{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{at}) ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT rate_card_id, provider_id, model_id, input_token_cost_per_1k, output_token_cost_per_1k, tool_call_cost, effective_from, effective_to FROM tb_cost_rate_card ORDER BY effective_from DESC
